description: Classic Roulette (Alegro/Ruleta) ERROR N screens that interrupt the game: Godot UI closes and a dedicated error window opens. Primary log signature is <TRIAL error="N" type="DISPLAYED"> in ruleta* logs (not slot).

1.title: The program was not shut down correctly (incorrect exit from the program).
possibleFaults: PC block.
Power supply cable of the PC.
Power supply cable of the UPS.
Roulette switched off with the POWER key.
Program stopped with the PC keyboard.

2.title: Fault on the main CPU.
possibleFaults: CPU on main PC is not responding.
COM 2 on PC is not working.
Check PC power supply.
Check serial communication cable.

3.title: During the check of the cylinder and sensors something was detected on the cylinder.
possibleFaults: The sensor is not set correctly.
There is dirt or dust on the cylinder.
Transmitting IR LED is not working or it is dirty.
The zero location sensor is not set correctly.

4.title: A mistake occurred during the sensor-reading period.
possibleFaults: The cylinder sensor is not set correctly.
Check the sensor cable and connections.
Check COM 2 cable.
Check that the PC is not overloaded.

5.title: During the blow period the sensor has not located the ball.
possibleFaults: Check the ball is not blocked in the blowing tube.
If the ball is on the cylinder check that the cylinder sensor is set correctly.

6.title: After the blow the status sensor has found the ball still on the start position.
possibleFaults: Check if the blow compressor is working.
Check if the status sensor is working.
Check there is no dust on start position sensor.

7.title: Power supply has failed.
possibleFaults: Check for mains power.
Check the fuses and circuit breakers.

8.title: The ball has not returned to the start position.
possibleFaults: Check the lift motor and the mechanism for correct operation.
Check that the ball is not stuck in the drop system or under the cylinder.
Check if the status sensor is working.

10.title: An error occurred during the writing of a database.
possibleFaults: Check databases.
Check that there are no errors on the hard disk.
Delete lock files and restart.

12.title: The cylinder has made the maximum number of turns and has failed to located the ball.
possibleFaults: After the blow out the ball has not arrived on the cylinder.
On start-up the program has not located the ball.
Check if the sensors are working.

13.title: The program automatically turns to safe start if the ball was not found for 2 rotations.
possibleFaults: Check the location of the ball.
Check if the sensors are working properly.

15.title: The program was not able to read from the database.
possibleFaults: Check there are errors on hard disk.

16.title: During the start the program was unable to open the databases.
possibleFaults: Check for errors on hard disk.
Check if the databases for corruption.

19.title: During initialization the program failed to open one or more communication ports.
possibleFaults: Check communication cards and ports are working properly.
Check if any other program is using the ports.

20.title: An error occurred on communication between the PC and COM 2.
possibleFaults: Check if COM 2 is working properly.
Check if CPU is responding.

21.title: Roulette hardware/communication fault (see possible faults).
possibleFaults: Check communication cards and cables.
Check all programs which are using com ports (commcontroller).

22.title: A mistake occurred during data transfer to the windows register.
possibleFaults: Check for errors on hard disk.
Check databases are not corrupt.
Delete playx.mdb databases using special tool.

23.title: During data processing a negative value occurred in base.
possibleFaults: Errors on hard disk.
Delete playx.mdb databases using special tool.

24.title: The program was not able to initialize the register.
possibleFaults: Errors on hard disk.
Check databases are not corrupt in folder.
Delete playx.mdb databases using special tool.

27.title: During initialization the program was unable to load BMP screen saver
possibleFaults: Errors on hard disk.
Reload BMP screen saver.

28.title: The program during start unable to run all graphics cards.
possibleFaults: Check if all the graphic cards are correctly located in the PCI slots.
Check if the correct drivers are loaded for graphic cards in use.

29.title: A fault occurred on communication with the i/o board and the mechanical counters.
possibleFaults: Check if COM1 works correctly.
Check if CPU on I/0 counter board is responding.
Check communication cable.
Check power supply to the I/O board.

30.title: Program locks on a predefined date and hour.
details: Program can be restarted with password.
Official RAM clear does not wipe ruleta/persistent (only ruleta/var).
A leftover RouletteActivate.dat from a prior SUCCEEDED enter keeps ERROR 30 after clock rollback.
possibleFaults: Expired RouletteActivate.dat in C:\goldclub\ruleta\persistent (survives RAM clear).
HeapDataFinanceStamps.dat still has the expire Unix time; a rolled-back clock looks like tamper.
Not leftover Aurum XML if WIBU serial is already logged and live 37A55022 licence exists.
30.solution: Config Scanner More → Clear ERROR 30 / 99 trial leftovers (backs up then deletes persistent trial files). Keep live licence XML and licence.dll. After restart expect ERROR 99 with a NEW challenge and enter that id. Do not restore an expired RouletteActivate.dat.

31.title: Program stops with activation of certain security switches.

32.title: A fault can happens during initialization any data for ticket printers or any other peripheral device.
possibleFaults: Check if ticket printers are connected properly (to correct COM port on multiplexer).

33.title: The program has not received enough information from the sensors.
possibleFaults: Check if the sensors are properly aligned.
Check sensor cables.
Check communication cable.
Check if the cylinder is spinning at the correct speed.

34.title: Timing error on banknote impulse.
possibleFaults: Control Banknote reader.
Control Cable on banknote reader.
Control Satellite I/O board under keyboard.

38.title: Timeout of online connection exceeded.
possibleFaults: Check if on-line system is connected to correct COM port.
Check if the same COM port is selected in Roulette Game Setup.

39.title: Speed variations detected on cylinder.
possibleFaults: Sensor faulty.
FM motor controller.
Control zero position sensor.

61.title: Sound error.
possibleFaults: Check if the sound card is working properly.

63.title: Error happens only when the main power is lost. If the error happens a lot of time please check the main fuse or the UPS.

64.title: Same as ERROR 63 (main power lost / UPS or main fuse).

65.title: The last game (cycle) is longer or shorter than the average cycle time.
details: Check the deviation in game setup (game settings/additional/ball read/max time diff).

66.title: Error initialization security switch system.
details: Check if security switch PCB is connected to the computer (GC Terminal).
Check if HWSubsys service is starting (BiOS\config\Services).

67.title: Error initialization tokens.
details: Check in game setup if the tokens and chips are set correctly.

69.title: Communication between the electronic roulette and the UPS is missing.
possibleFaults: Faulty COM cable.
Wrong COM setting (speed, mapping, etc.).
UPS not defined in configuration (HW drivers).

72.title: Communication problem with satellite (NEON).
details: Check main power supply. Check communication with satellite.

99.title: Dongle / trial bind required (fresh LLAVE).
details: Logged as Dongle mismatch!!! then TRIAL error="99" type="DISPLAYED".
Empty RouletteActivate.dat (all zeros) after wiping an expired token.
possibleFaults: Wrong keypad code for this challenge (old ERROR 30 codes fail).
Not a missing Aurum XML if WIBU serial is already logged.
99.solution: Enter the password for the System ID on screen. Success is SUCCEEDED with no Trial expired within about 15 seconds, then Bets are open. Keep live licence XML and licence.dll.
